# Four-rubric transfer protocol

Frozen before scoring. Use the parent study's pinned V3 development archive and V2 provenance only. Match ID and whitespace-normalized, lowercased full history. In each direction train on the opposite source after excluding target openings (normalized prefix before first Student marker). Exclude unlinked cases from transfer. Compare Gemini, GPT4, Llama31405B, Llama318B, Mistral and Sonnet on identical conversations. Require every candidate to have Yes, No or To some extent on Mistake_Identification, Mistake_Location, Providing_Guidance and Actionability. Report raw labels including missing or NA before exclusions.

Maximize training successes separately for guidance Yes and simultaneous four Yes, breaking ties alphabetically. On target cases compare both choices, uniform choice in expectation and per-case oracle under each endpoint. Report paired differences against the guidance-selected tutor with percentile 95% intervals from 10,000 opening-cluster bootstrap samples, seed 42, conditional on fitting. Count strict tutor-pair ordering reversals on changing endpoint, ignoring ties. Results describe annotation agreement, not student learning.
